issues.issue: Can the Court hear this appeal of a Federal Court order amended under Rule 397(1)(a), with no certified question?
issues.applicant_position: The Federal Court judge was functus officio and had no jurisdiction to amend the order under Rule 397(1)(a).
issues.respondent_position: The February order was a slip; amending it under Rule 397(1)(a) to match the reasons was proper.
issues.result_quote: This ground does not fall within the well-defined, narrow circumstances in which this Court will entertain an appeal.

issues.issue: Should the notice of appeal be removed from the court file under Rules 72 and 74 for want of jurisdiction?
issues.applicant_position: The appeal should proceed on its only ground: the judge lacked jurisdiction under Rule 397(1)(a).
issues.result_quote: For the above reasons, I would order that the notice of appeal be removed from the Court file. The appeal cannot proceed.
